task_summary: Decide the initial angular-rate PI range and acceleration/deceleration test profile from a project handoff.
evidence: Local handoff, actual phase-generation source, and existing matched historical comparison
observations: The latest handoff was a local document and its suggested user command did not control the full emitted test profile. Inspecting the phase source prevented a false lower-target assumption.
The prior yaw results used different wheel gains and fan conditions. They guide the bracket but do not establish an accepted tune.
limits: The planned angular-rate profile and gains have not been deployed or exercised on the vehicle

metrics.name: Independent reviews
metrics.basis: Read-only handoff and historical measurement cross-check

completed: Read and cross-checked the handoff against the current source, latest wheel logs and historical yaw captures
Recorded a conservative first-run plan and staged search criteria
acceptance: Read the full newest handoff and distinguish wheel PI from yaw PI
Check the actual firmware profile and historical controls before proposing initial bounds
